notes.title: WWE 2K16 has been updated [patch 1.01]
notes.notes:
[b][u]Today's update includes the following:[/u][/b]

[list]
[*] Reduced loading time for all supported machine specs.  This fix does increase memory the footprint for the loading screens and may impact Min Spec users if they play with a lot background process running concurrently with the title, in which case load times will revert to their original, pre-patch times.
[*] Fixed crash in Community Creations associated with backing out while items are loading and then re-entering the download menu.
[*] Fixed crash during custom entrances that contain simultaneous video effect and pyrotechnics
[/list]
